# Alibaba Cloud Server Load Balancer
> Alibaba Cloud’s international documentation and product pages for Server Load Balancer, including CLB, NLB, ALB, APIs, and operational guides.

This site provides product documentation for Alibaba Cloud load balancing services on the international site, covering feature overviews, getting started material, API references, user guides, pricing, and related networking integrations.

## Product Overview
- [Server Load Balancer](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/server-load-balancer): Product overview for Alibaba Cloud load balancing services and core capabilities.
- [Application Load Balancer](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/alb): Overview of Layer 7 load balancing for HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC workloads.
- [Network Load Balancer](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/network-load-balancer): Overview of high-performance Layer 4 load balancing for TCP and UDP traffic.
- [Classic Load Balancer](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/slb): Overview of traditional Alibaba Cloud load balancing for general-purpose scenarios.
- [Elastic IP Address](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/eip): Public IP service commonly used with load balancing deployments.
- [Virtual Private Cloud](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/vpc): Core networking service used to build isolated environments for load balancers.

## Server Load Balancer Documentation
- [Server Load Balancer Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb): Main documentation hub for Server Load Balancer on the international site.
- [What is Server Load Balancer?](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/product-overview/what-is-server-load-balancer): Introduction to Server Load Balancer concepts, editions, and use cases.
- [Benefits](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/product-overview/benefits): Summary of key advantages and service capabilities.
- [Features](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/product-overview/features): Feature overview for traffic distribution, availability, and protocol support.
- [Release Notes](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/release-notes): Product updates, feature releases, and service changes.
- [FAQ](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/faq): Frequently asked questions about configuration, billing, and operations.

## Application Load Balancer Docs
- [ALB Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer): Documentation hub for Application Load Balancer.
- [What is ALB?](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer/product-overview/what-is-alb): Introduction to Application Load Balancer architecture and scenarios.
- [Get Started with ALB](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer/getting-started): Entry point for creating and configuring ALB resources.
- [Listeners](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer/user-guide/listeners): Guidance on configuring HTTP and HTTPS listeners.
- [Server Groups](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer/user-guide/server-groups): How to manage backend server groups for ALB.
- [Routing Rules](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer/user-guide/routing-rules): Configure forwarding rules based on hostnames and URL paths.
- [Certificates](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer/user-guide/certificates): Manage TLS certificates for secure HTTPS traffic.

## Network Load Balancer Docs
- [NLB Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer): Documentation hub for Network Load Balancer.
- [What is NLB?](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer/product-overview/what-is-nlb): Introduction to Layer 4 load balancing and high-throughput scenarios.
- [Get Started with NLB](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer/getting-started): Setup guidance for creating and using NLB instances.
- [Listeners](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer/user-guide/listeners): Configure TCP and UDP listeners for NLB traffic handling.
- [Server Groups](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer/user-guide/server-groups): Manage backend targets and health check associations.
- [Health Checks](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer/user-guide/health-checks): Configure backend health monitoring for NLB services.
- [Zonal Deployment](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer/user-guide/zonal-deployment): Guidance on multi-zone deployment and availability design.

## Classic Load Balancer Docs
- [CLB Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer): Documentation hub for Classic Load Balancer.
- [What is CLB?](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer/product-overview/what-is-clb): Introduction to Classic Load Balancer and supported scenarios.
- [Get Started with CLB](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer/getting-started): Initial setup instructions for CLB instances and listeners.
- [Listeners](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer/user-guide/listeners): Configure Layer 4 and Layer 7 listeners for CLB.
- [Backend Servers](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer/user-guide/backend-servers): Add and manage backend ECS instances for CLB.
- [Health Checks](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer/user-guide/health-checks): Configure health checks to monitor backend availability.
- [Access Control](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer/user-guide/access-control): Manage ACLs and traffic access policies for CLB.

## API Reference
- [SLB API Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/developer-reference/api-overview): Overview of API operations for Server Load Balancer services.
- [ALB API Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/application-load-balancer/developer-reference): API operations for managing ALB resources and configurations.
- [NLB API Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/network-load-balancer/developer-reference): API operations for provisioning and operating NLB instances.
- [CLB API Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/classic-load-balancer/developer-reference): API operations for Classic Load Balancer management.
- [OpenAPI Explorer](https://api.alibabacloud.com/): Interactive API explorer for Alibaba Cloud services and SDK generation.
- [Alibaba Cloud SDK](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sdk): SDK documentation for calling Alibaba Cloud APIs programmatically.

- [Terms](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/slb/service-linked-roles): Service-linked roles and permission-related operational requirements.

## Integration and Related Services
- [Web Application Firewall](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/web-application-firewall): Security service commonly deployed in front of web applications and ALB.
- [Anti-DDoS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/anti-ddos): DDoS protection service for internet-facing applications and endpoints.
- [Cloud Monitor](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/cloudmonitor): Monitoring and alerting service for load balancer metrics and health.
- [Elastic Compute Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/ecs): Compute instances frequently used as backend servers behind load balancers.
- [Container Service for Kubernetes](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/kubernetes): Managed Kubernetes service that integrates with Alibaba Cloud load balancers.
- [PrivateLink](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/privatelink): Private connectivity service relevant to internal application architectures.

- [NLB Pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/pricing/product/network-load-balancer): Pricing details for Network Load Balancer instances and traffic.
- [CLB Pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/pricing/product/slb): Pricing details for Classic Load Balancer usage.
- [Free Trial](https://www.alibabacloud.com/campaign/free-trial): Trial offers that may include networking and load balancing services.
